comment: DATED EVIDENCE, NOT A LIVE CHECK. `cargo test` here cannot see neural-memory-server, and there is no runtime oracle: its MCP surface exposes no tool returning the enum, because the agent write channel clamps to a single class before the digest is computed (see agentWritableClasses). This file is the chain back to source — repo, path, line range, commit, and the sha256 of the file the names were READ FROM at that commit. Drift is then one hash comparison; scripts/check-evidence-class-drift.sh confirms it against a checkout when one is present.

upstream.comment: Mirrored FROM neural-memory-server. Adding a name here is a claim that the enum changed, and must be re-read from source.

localExtensions.comment: OURS. No upstream counterpart, deliberately — a threshold whose own source calls it unvalidated is not evidence at any confidence, so it must map to NeverIngestible rather than to any evidence class. Kept separate from `upstream` so an upstream addition and a local one are not indistinguishable to the drift check; without the split the check would need a hardcoded exclusion list, which is its own place to drift.

agentWritableClasses.comment: The only evidence class reachable through the MCP write door. Recorded as data rather than as ADR prose so that wiring a second path fails the suite instead of quietly making the prose false. A subset of upstream.evidenceClasses by construction.
